study: 02 only; local two-site assignment calibration, not shell RSMI, not a new phase
population: All 163840 L20 parents. Use the prior independent 8192/8192 TRAIN/TEST per beta; TEST held out of the fit but not an untouched archive. One fit per beta and seed, 30 total.
pairs: 50 candidates per parent. Before reading species, fixed PCG64 [209157,beta-index,chain_seed,chain_id] supplies one periodic origin and 50 independent fair orientation bits. For each of 5x5 transverse grid locations spaced by 4, pair x=0 with x=8 and x=4 with x=12 (periodic shift in z,y,x). All 100 stars are disjoint; pair L1 distance 8; each six-neighbor mask excludes both centers, no shared neighbor. No redraw, no per-parent normalization. Retain iff both centers occupied and exactly one A; every retained row weight one. Publish all inventory and occupancy-only/both-occupied/unlike counts, parent and orientation support. Directions z-,z+,y-,y+,x-,x+. Same candidate set and eligibility for all optimizer seeds.
model: Stock Conv2DSingle ll=(1,6), visible_dim=2 (sites i,j), hidden_dim=2. V contains only 12 neighbor OCCUPANCIES, not center species, m, d, beta or coordinates. E one-hot for which site is A. Stock SeparableCritic (3 layers,hidden32,embed8,dropout .2), relaxed binary logits, Adam .009, stock shuffle 100000, batch 500, retains partial. For each beta: epochs=ceil(10000/ceil(n_train/500)); cover all eligible rows every epoch. Checkpoints at exact updates 850,1700,3400,6800,final >=10000 on one trajectory. Seeds 6101,6102,6103 paired between temperatures. Preserve failures independently, no retries/selection. No extra MCMC.
physical_law: d=m_i-m_j. Conditional on unlike pair, P(i=A|d)=expit(-4 beta d). For k=abs(d)>0 favorable means A at lower m; for k=0 report i=A, not 'lower'. Test k=0..6 individually and signed d=-6..6, both label orientations. All pairs pooled with equal inclusion weight; uncertainty across independent parents. Count favorable and reverse, actual supporting parents. Where a tail count is zero, report one-sided bound on supported-parent any-rare incidence and conservative cluster upper bound on rare pair rate, not zero uncertainty. Rare upper uses P(Y>0|N>0) Clopper-Pearson and N<=50 with a simultaneous Hoeffding lower bound on E[N|N>0].
frozen_assessment: Same immutable TEST parents at all starts/depths. Each parent belongs to one of 32 disjoint blocks of 256 parents in roster order. Deterministically permute eligible rows within block (PCG64 [209158,b,block]); divide into near-equal groups <=500; fixed derangement per group [209159,b,block,group]. Critic rows H, columns assignment; compute the two critic scores per H (there are only two distinct E), gather actual score matrix for stock TFP InfoNCE real/shuffled; same relaxed draw and scores. Float64 equivalent two-column row-centered logsumexp on the SAME contrastive groups. Flag nonfinite/above log(n)+1e-5 or absolute diff >.001 nat; keep raw and flags. Evaluate exact Hamiltonian log P(E|d) with SAME true/deranged group assignments (uniform oriented prior cancels); negative-control constant score gives exactly zero. Do not call accuracy or true-minus-shuffled a mutual-information estimate.
rule: At each saved checkpoint, obtain TRAIN relaxed codes (training=False), hard threshold >=.5. Freeze four-entry sign table: for each code compare observed P(code|d<0) versus P(code|d>0), assign expected lower site i/j, ties or unseen abstain for half credit. No TEST rule choices, permutations or polarity fitting. Held sign balanced accuracy averages the two d orientations; no lower site for ties. Archive proper baselines frozen from TRAIN: scalar orientation intercept, occupancy-only P(i=A|m_i+m_j), and empirical k-favorable Jeffreys-smoothed lookup (orient by sign, tie 1/2). Compare Brier vs stock critic posterior using score[1]-score[0], vs analytic and empirical law; report physical reverse-event precision and code usage. Exact sign oracle accuracy 1, assignment accuracy logistic(4 beta k) not necessarily 1; beta=0 and d=0 are specificity controls for assignment, not for occupancy geometry itself.
decisions: Report all beta/seed/depth and k, no winner selection. Primary learnability at beta=3.05 final requires all three finite, clean fits; non-tie balanced sign accuracy lower 95% >.55, Brier improvement over occupancy-only lower 95% >0, genuine-pair stock score advantage lower 95% >0 in each. Calibrate against exact odds; do not interpret zero reversals as infinite evidence or failure to reject as verification of exact equilibrium. Negative controls: tie and beta-zero empirical A fraction vs 1/2 and within-group shuffled score/gain. Intervals pointwise parent-cluster sandwich t, paired differences within same parents; stock batch score uncertainties use 32 disjoint parent blocks. No seed pooling for uncertainty; poorly supported strata marked. No further tasks or tuning.
